answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fake identities. Each agent pays a non-refundable fee, twice its expected 30-day earnings, and the fee burns. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 fees; one honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards. Each dawn, audits expose clusters sharing one funding source, as light in karst caves reveals passages, and exposed clusters forfeit fees. A pearl forms slowly, and so does trust: one identity beats a thousand cheap copies.
